name: zillion
description: Zillion is a private chat powered by an advanced mix of Nostr and e2e encryption.
author: arthurfranca

scripts.// link:nappup: Register the nappup checkout with the current Node/npm installation and restore the local link.
scripts.// start: Start/reuse the local launcher and install watched builds locally after 250 ms.
scripts.// start:adb: Run the local watcher with Android port forwarding and Chrome/Edge console logs.
scripts.// start:publish: Watch files and publish drafts to the real network after a 2s debounce.
scripts.// start:publish:adb: Publish watched drafts with Android forwarding and console logs.
scripts.// upload: Build and publish to the main channel.
scripts.// upload:draft: Build and publish once to the draft channel.
scripts.// test:browser: Run Chrome tests against the real local runtime in disposable profiles.
scripts.// serve: Preview dist/zillion/ on port 4000 without injected runtime APIs.
scripts.// test:only: Run only Node tests marked with only.
scripts.// test:browser:attachments: Run the file, gallery-recovery, download-intent and compression scenarios in one guarded unit, without the controlled gallery fixture.
scripts.// test:browser:gallery-ui: Run the controlled gallery fixture in its own guarded unit; it is kept out of the attachments run to preserve the 3 GiB margin.
